run_command_subprocess: run a shell command with a timeout and capture stdout, raising OSError on failure
communicate_with_timeout: communicate with a subprocess and kill it automatically if the timeout expires
Popen_context_manager: use a context manager that wraps subprocess.Popen and kills the process on scope exit
run_command_compile_job: run a compilation job command with timeout and get stderr details on failure
communicate_safe_subprocess: safely communicate with a subprocess that kills stubborn processes on timeout
